availability.note: e VITARA Motion listed with a 'From' drive-away price on Suzuki AU model page on 2026-11-27, with a Build & Price link (/vehicles/electric/e-vitara/build-and-price/); the configurator's price data could not be fetched (permission refused), so grade count also checked against Suzuki AU offers page and CarsGuide 2027 price list (Ultra 2WD is Qld-only)

listPrice.note: Suzuki AU Black Friday offer (ends 30 Nov 2026) for Motion in Bluish Black Pearl: 'Offer provides 10% off the Manufacturer's Recommended Retail Price (RRP)', 'Save $4,874'. With $745 premium paint (CarExpert launch article) 10% x ($47,990 + $745) = $4,873.5, rounding to $4,874. Same $47,990 is Glass's MSRP on https://www.carsguide.com.au/suzuki/e-vitara/price/2027 ('excludes costs such as stamp duty, other government charges and options'). Suzuki publishes no list price in words; its advertised drive-away is $46,990 (https://www.suzuki.com.au/vehicles/electric/e-vitara/), BELOW app-computed Vic drive-away of $50,886 — a Suzuki-funded drive-away campaign, not a list price. Lead of $49,990/$58,990 drive-away not found on any current Suzuki page.
